summary: Curation probe: grade all live PARALLELS edges offline against via-concept queries; suspect queue proposal, no writes
description: The organized-better thread (owner, 2026-08-12): via = intersect the two chunks EXPRESSES concepts; grade each of the ~11,300 PARALLELS edges with the student against its via-concept canonical queries (per-concept static grading is legitimate; per-arbitrary-query static weights are the proven dead end). Deliverables: score distribution report, hub decomposition (the degree-177 Boehme hubs), empty-via count, and a suspect-edge queue PROPOSAL — queue-only, no guru.db writes, owner keeps the apply gate.

resolution.note: All 11,300 PARALLELS edges graded on GPU in minutes: 83.3% share >=1 EXPRESSES concept (via), 16.7% (1,884) share NONE — suspect by construction. 9,393 graded by min-leg student score vs their best via-concept; suspect queue PROPOSAL = 1,884 empty-via + 941 low-grade (bottom decile) = 2,825 edges (25%). Hub decomposition confirms Boehme.116 (deg 177) etc. No db writes; owner keeps the apply gate. NOTE: concept graph nodes are namespaced concept.<id> vs bare taxonomy keys — probe maps them.
